title: The Path to Self-Evolving Clinical Systems: Scaling Medical Agents from Assistance to Autonomy
abstract: arXiv:2607.11175v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The growing ability of large language models and vision-language models to jointly interpret and reason over images and text is reshaping medical imaging AI, moving it from task-specific predictors toward autonomous agents that perceive, reason, plan, remember, and act in clinical environments. This survey departs from the capability-first perspective of existing literature and instead begins from clinical deployment, asking what tasks, contamination-resistant benchmarks, and interactive training environments are required before medical agents can be trusted in practice. Medical agents are formalized as sequential decision-making systems under partial observability, together with a three-level autonomy taxonomy spanning assisted, cooperative, and fully autonomous operation. translated_title: 迈向自进化临床系统：将医疗智能体从辅助扩展到自主的路径
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型和视觉-语言模型联合解释和推理图像与文本的能力不断增强，正在重塑医学影像人工智能，使其从任务特定的预测器转向能够在临床环境中感知、推理、规划、记忆和行动的自主智能体。本综述不同于现有文献以能力优先的视角，而是从临床部署出发，探讨在医疗智能体能够在实践中被信任之前，需要哪些任务、抗污染基准和交互式训练环境。医疗智能体被形式化为部分可观测下的序列决策系统，并附带一个涵盖辅助、协作和完全自主操作的三级自主性分类。该领域沿着一个统一的扩展主轴组织，包括框架扩展、能力扩展和环境扩展。在此框架内，临床...
tldr: 本文提出一种以临床部署为中心的医疗智能体框架，通过三级自主性分类和统一扩展路径，系统性地推动医疗AI从辅助角色向自主临床系统进化。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a clinical-deployment-centric framework for medical agents, featuring a three-level autonomy taxonomy and a unified scaling pathway, systematically advancing medical AI from assistive roles toward autonomous clinical systems.
